name: Naka (Ibaraki, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Naka city emblem in white: an outlined ring with a stylised device of horizontal strokes at the fly, like a letter G.
history: Municipal flag of Naka, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1959.

features.role: Naka city emblem — an outlined ring with a stylised device of horizontal strokes at the fly, like a letter G
